name: Urabe Emi
source:
Likes: Gâteau au chocolat from Kinds Cafe, animals
Dislikes: Exercising, mean people
Hobbies: Baking sweets, reading (mainly mystery novels)

A student from Class 2-4. She’s a naturally charming, plump, glasses-wearing girl who radiates cheerfulness. [url=/c11335]Mitsuki[/url], [url=/c11334]Touko[/url], and she have been best friends since first grade. She likes fortunetelling, and was the one who found and told her friends about the Sachiko Ever After charm. After performing it with her classmates, she ended up trapped in Heavenly Host.

[From [url=https://corpseparty.fandom.com/wiki/Emi_Urabe]Corpse Party Wiki[/url]]
